item.title: HINO MOTORS PHL REINFORCES COMMITMENT TO CUSTOMER BENEFITS
item.description: For businesses that rely on commercial vehicles, purchasing a truck is only the beginning of the ownership journey.

item.title: MDPPA maps school-zone detours
item.description: The Motorcycle Development Program Participants Association (MDPPA) has released a traffic guide that identifies alternative routes around some of Metro Manila’s busiest school zones.

item.title: Suzuki brings electrified lineup to MOA
item.description: Suzuki Philippines will display its latest hybrids and first battery-electric vehicle at the “Good Vibes Ahead” Auto Festival at the SM Mall of Asia (MOA) Central Atrium this weekend.

item.title: Michelin expands distribution
item.description: Michelin Philippines has appointed three new importer-distributors to cover passenger cars, commercial fleets and specialized industries. The appointments increase its local distributor network from four companies to seven.

item.title: Toyota’s lasting value
item.description: Buying a car comes with a brief honeymoon, when the spotless paint and new-car smell make even the usual ride or errand a bit more special.

item.title: BRC thriller
item.description: Alain Gabriel Alzona scored two Super Sporting Class victories during the first TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Philippine Cup round at Batangas Racing Circuit, where close fights and several collisions shaped Race Weekend 3.
